description: Walking onto a stair flight (world/vertical.rs, the body walks the treads of render/stairs.rs): walking forward down the nearest flight reaches the storey below, and walking forward up from there returns to the storey above. The level changes only through the shared hysteresis (level_from_height). Standing still on the landing does not change the level.
ported_from: game/player/player_controller_3d.gd floor snap and stairs; world/vertical.rs stair_surface_y, level_from_height

tests.name: standing on the landing of a flight down keeps the storey
walking forward down a flight reaches level -1 at depth 2
walking forward up from level -1 returns to level 0
